setup: Upright bench under the bar, safeties set
Bar just in front of your face when seated
Grip a little wider than your shoulders
execution: Unhook the bar and brace your trunk
Lower to about chin or upper-chest height
Press straight up to straight arms
Twist the bar to re-hook at the top
faults: Don't press from behind your neck
Don't arch your lower back off the pad
Don't flare your elbows straight out

notes: Set the safety stops just below the lowest point of your rep, so a missed rep lands on the stops, not on you.
Practise hooking and unhooking with an empty bar first; the hooks catch only when the bar is twisted.
Keep the bar path in front of the head; behind-the-neck pressing puts the shoulder in an extreme position.
Smith bar weight differs between gyms, so the number logged is plates added, not the total.
If pain lingers or comes back, stop this exercise and get it checked by a physio or doctor.
stopIf: Pain that changes how you move
